Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 1) Isoniazid mainly acts by inhibiting:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Isoniazid inhibits mycolic acid synthesis. Mycolic acid is important for mycobacterial cell wall. This is why INH is a key first-line anti-TB drug.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 2) Major adverse effect of isoniazid is:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Isoniazid commonly causes peripheral neuropathy. Hepatitis and rash may also occur. Pyridoxine reduces neuropathy risk.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 3) Isoniazid-induced peripheral neuropathy is prevented by:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Pyridoxine is vitamin B6. It reduces INH-induced peripheral neuropathy. It is especially important in high-risk patients.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 4) Rifampicin acts by inhibiting:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Rifampicin inhibits DNA-dependent RNA polymerase. This blocks bacterial RNA synthesis. It is a first-line anti-TB drug.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 5) A classic feature of rifampicin is:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Rifampicin may discolor urine, tears and other body fluids orange-red. It is also a potent enzyme inducer. Patients should be warned about this harmless discoloration.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 6) Pyrazinamide commonly causes:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Pyrazinamide may cause hyperuricaemia. It can precipitate gout. Hepatitis and GI disturbance may also occur.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 7) Ethambutol toxicity is classically:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Ethambutol can cause retrobulbar neuritis. Visual toxicity is important clinically. Dose and renal function should be considered.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 8) During ethambutol therapy, monitoring should include:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Ethambutol may damage optic nerve. Visual acuity and red-green colour vision should be monitored. Early detection helps prevent severe visual loss.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 9) Pyrazinamide is especially active in:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Pyrazinamide activity is linked with acidic pH. Its exact mechanism is uncertain. It is an important first-line anti-TB drug.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 10) Rifampicin may rarely cause:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Rifampicin may cause thrombocytopenia rarely. Interstitial nephritis and haemolytic anaemia may also occur. Hepatitis and rash are more commonly remembered.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 11) Natural penicillins include:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Benzylpenicillin and phenoxymethylpenicillin are natural penicillins. They belong to beta-lactam antibiotics. Classification of penicillins is a common recall area.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 12) Penicillinase-resistant penicillins include:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Flucloxacillin, nafcillin and oxacillin resist penicillinase. Meticillin is also in this group. They are useful against penicillinase-producing organisms.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 13) Aminopenicillins include:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Ampicillin and amoxicillin are aminopenicillins. They are beta-lactam antibiotics. They have broader activity than natural penicillins.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 14) Carboxy- and ureido-penicillins include:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Ticarcillin, piperacillin and temocillin are carboxy-/ureido-penicillin group drugs. They are extended-spectrum penicillins. Piperacillin is commonly used with tazobactam.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 15) Which group contains cephalosporins?
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Cephalexin, cefuroxime and ceftriaxone are cephalosporins. They are beta-lactam antibiotics. Different generations have different spectra.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 16) The monobactam antibiotic is:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Aztreonam is the only monobactam. It belongs to beta-lactam antibiotics. It is often remembered for relative safety in many penicillin-allergic patients.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 17) Carbapenems include:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Imipenem, meropenem, ertapenem and doripenem are carbapenems. They are beta-lactam antibiotics. They have very broad antibacterial spectrum.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 18) Among beta-lactams, the broadest spectrum group is commonly:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Carbapenems are broad-spectrum beta-lactams. They are used for serious resistant infections. Imipenem and meropenem are common examples.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 19) Aztreonam is often useful because it is:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.option2: Always active against all gram-positive bacteria
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Aztreonam is a monobactam. It has low cross-reactivity with many penicillin allergies. It is mainly useful against gram-negative organisms.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 20) Antipsychotic drugs are mainly used in:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Antipsychotics are used in schizophrenia, mania and delirium. They may be typical or atypical. Adverse effects depend on dopamine, cholinergic and other receptor effects.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 21) Antidepressant drug groups include:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Major antidepressant groups include TCAs, SSRIs, SNRIs and MAOIs. Mirtazapine and esketamine are also antidepressant options. They are used in depression, anxiety and OCD.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 22) Mood stabilizers include:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Lithium, valproate and lamotrigine are mood stabilizers. They are commonly used in bipolar disorder. Lithium is classically remembered as the gold-standard mood stabilizer.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 23) Anxiolytics include:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Benzodiazepines and beta-blockers are listed under anxiolytics. They are used for anxiety-related symptoms. Benzodiazepines are also used in insomnia and alcohol withdrawal.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 24) A phenothiazine antipsychotic is:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Chlorpromazine is a phenothiazine. It is a typical antipsychotic. It can produce dopamine blockade-related adverse effects.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 25) A butyrophenone antipsychotic is:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Haloperidol is a butyrophenone. It has high risk of extrapyramidal symptoms. It is a high-yield typical antipsychotic.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 26) A thioxanthene antipsychotic is:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Flupentixol decanoate is a thioxanthene. It is an antipsychotic drug. Depot preparations may be used in long-term treatment.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 27) A diphenylbutylpiperidine antipsychotic is:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Pimozide belongs to diphenylbutylpiperidines. It is an antipsychotic drug. Classification questions often test examples.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 28) A substituted benzamide antipsychotic is:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Sulpiride is a substituted benzamide. It is included among antipsychotic groups. It is different from phenothiazines and butyrophenones.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 29) Clozapine belongs to:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Clozapine is a dibenzodiazepine antipsychotic. It is atypical. Neutropenia or agranulocytosis is the key adverse effect.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 30) Risperidone belongs to:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Risperidone is a benzisoxazole. It is an atypical antipsychotic. It can still cause extrapyramidal effects and prolactin-related effects.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 31) Olanzapine belongs to:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Olanzapine is a thienobenzodiazepine. It is an atypical antipsychotic. Weight gain and metabolic effects are important.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 32) Quetiapine belongs to:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Quetiapine is a dibenzothiazepine. It is an atypical antipsychotic. EPS risk is relatively less severe compared with many typical drugs.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 33) Dopamine blockade by antipsychotics can cause:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.option4: Acute dystonia, akathisia, parkinsonism and tardive dyskinesia
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Dopamine blockade causes extrapyramidal symptoms. It may also cause gynaecomastia and galactorrhoea. Haloperidol has high EPS risk.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 34) Cholinergic blockade by antipsychotics may cause:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.option2: Dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation and urinary retention
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Anticholinergic effects include dry mouth and blurred vision. Constipation and urinary retention are also common. These are due to cholinergic blockade.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 35) Clozapine-associated neutropenia is grouped under:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Clozapine can cause neutropenia or agranulocytosis. Regular CBC monitoring is required. This adverse effect is very important clinically.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 36) Long-term antipsychotic use may cause ocular complications such as:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Long-term antipsychotic therapy may cause corneal and lens opacities. This is listed under ocular complications. Duration of therapy matters.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 37) Extrapyramidal effects are usually less severe with:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: These atypical antipsychotics have less severe EPS. They have weaker dopamine blockade and serotonin-blocking effects. But weight gain and metabolic effects may be more important.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 38) Highest risk of extrapyramidal symptoms is associated with:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Haloperidol has high dopamine D2 blockade. It is strongly associated with EPS. Acute dystonia, parkinsonism and akathisia may occur.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 39) Clozapine requires regular monitoring of:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Clozapine may cause neutropenia or agranulocytosis. CBC monitoring is necessary. This is a classic safety point.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 40) Clozapine, olanzapine and quetiapine are known for lower EPS but higher risk of:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Atypical antipsychotics may cause weight gain. Olanzapine and clozapine are especially important. Metabolic monitoring is clinically useful.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 41) Tricyclic antidepressants include:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Amitriptyline, imipramine, dosulepin and clomipramine are TCAs. They are older antidepressants. They have anticholinergic and cardiac toxicity concerns.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 42) SSRIs include:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.option1: Fluoxetine, sertraline, paroxetine, citalopram and escitalopram
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Fluoxetine, sertraline, paroxetine, citalopram and escitalopram are SSRIs. SSRIs are first-line antidepressants. They are also used in anxiety and OCD.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 43) MAO inhibitors include:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Phenelzine, tranylcypromine and moclobemide are MAO inhibitors. They are antidepressant drugs. Dietary and drug interaction cautions are important.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 44) SNRIs include:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Venlafaxine and duloxetine are SNRIs. They inhibit serotonin and noradrenaline reuptake. They are used in depression and anxiety disorders.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 45) Mirtazapine is classified as:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Mirtazapine is a noradrenaline and specific serotonergic inhibitor. It is an antidepressant. Sedation and weight gain are clinically relevant.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 46) Esketamine is classified as:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Esketamine is an NMDA antagonist. It is used in selected depressive disorders. It is different from classical monoamine reuptake inhibitors.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 47) First-line antidepressants are commonly:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: SSRIs are first-line antidepressants. They are generally better tolerated than TCAs and MAOIs. They are also useful in anxiety and OCD.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 48) Clomipramine belongs to:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Clomipramine is a tricyclic antidepressant. It is also well known for use in OCD. TCA adverse effects include anticholinergic and cardiac toxicity.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 49) Sertraline is classified as:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Sertraline is an SSRI. It is used in depression and anxiety disorders. It is also commonly used in OCD.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 50) Antidepressants are used in depression, anxiety and:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Antidepressants are used in depression and anxiety. They may also be used in OCD. SSRIs and clomipramine are important examples.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 51) The gold-standard mood stabilizer is:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Lithium is classically the gold-standard mood stabilizer. It is used in bipolar disorder. It has a narrow therapeutic index and needs monitoring.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 52) Valproate and lamotrigine are mainly used as:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Valproate and lamotrigine are mood stabilizers. They are commonly used in bipolar disorder. Valproate has important pregnancy cautions.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 53) Weight gain with antipsychotics is mainly due to:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Antipsychotic-associated weight gain is linked with increased appetite. It is especially important with some atypical drugs. Metabolic monitoring is useful during long-term therapy.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 54) Dopamine blockade may cause gynaecomastia and galactorrhoea due to:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Dopamine normally inhibits prolactin release. Dopamine blockade may increase prolactin. This can cause galactorrhoea, gynaecomastia and menstrual disturbance.

Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.question: 55) The best matched pair is:
Anti TB drug, Anti depressant, Anti Psyc.exp: Pyrazinamide commonly causes hyperuricaemia. Ethambutol causes retrobulbar neuritis. Rifampicin causes orange-red body fluids, and INH causes peripheral neuropathy.
